title: Schedule & Targets Tab
description: Schedule & Targets Tab documentation for Practice Admin.
overview: This guide covers schedule & targets tab workflows for Practice Admin.

subtasks.title: Configure Daily Schedule
subtasks.purpose: Set the practice’s default daily anchor times (Wake-up, Breakfast, Lunch, Dinner, Bed).

steps.title: Open Schedule & Targets
steps.description: Click the Schedule & Targets tab.

steps.title: Set Daily Schedule Times
steps.description: Under Daily Schedule, set Wake-up Time (default 06:00 AM), Breakfast Time (08:00 AM), Lunch Time (12:00 PM), Dinner Time (06:00 PM) and Bed Time (10:00 PM).

steps.title: Save or Cancel Schedule
steps.description: Click Save at the top-right; use Cancel to discard changes.

steps.title: Review Schedule Audit Log
steps.description: Click Event Logs to view an audit trail of previous changes. Notes All five anchor times are required (marked with a red asterisk). Changes take effect for readings uploaded after the save; historical readings retain their original window.

subtasks.title: Configure Blood Pressure Targets
subtasks.purpose: Define the four measurement windows (Wake-up, Morning, Noon, Afternoon) and target Systolic / Diastolic ranges.

steps.title: Scroll to BP Targets
steps.description: Scroll to the Blood Pressure Targets section.

steps.title: Set BP Time Windows
steps.description: For each window (Wake-up, Morning, Noon, Afternoon), set the Start – End time range.

steps.title: Set Systolic/Diastolic Ranges
steps.description: For each window, enter the Systolic Pressure target range (e.g. 100–142) and Diastolic Pressure target range (e.g. 100–113 for Wake-up, 50–80 for Morning / Noon).

steps.title: Save or Cancel Targets
steps.description: Click Save to persist, or Cancel to revert. Notes Windows must not overlap — validation flags any conflicts before Save is accepted. Readings outside the target range render in red on the Patients grid and trigger Abnormal Readings alerts.

subtasks.title: Configure Blood Glucose Targets
subtasks.purpose: Define meal-related BG windows and target ranges (Wake-up, Before-Meal, After-Meal, Bedtime, Midnight and pre / post-meal times for Breakfast / Lunch / Dinner).

steps.title: Scroll to Glucose Targets
steps.description: Scroll to the Blood Glucose Targets section.

steps.title: Set Glucose Target Ranges
steps.description: Set the target range (Low – High mg/dL) for Wake-up Target Rangeup Time, Before-Meal Target Range, After-Meal Target Range, Bedtime Target Range and Midnight Target Range (typical defaults 60–110 / 70–140).

steps.title: Set Wake-Up Window
steps.description: Set the Wake-up Time window (e.g. 06:00 AM – 11:00 AM).

steps.title: Set Meal Time Windows
steps.description: Set the Before-Breakfast, After-Breakfast, Before-Lunch, After-Lunch, Before-Dinner, After-Dinner windows using the Start – End time pickers.

steps.title: Set Bedtime & Midnight Windows
steps.description: Set the Bedtime and Midnight time windows.

steps.title: Save or Review History
steps.description: Click Save; use Cancel to discard or Event Logs to view history. Notes All BG window fields are required (marked with red asterisks). Windows are chronological — a Before-Lunch start after the Lunch anchor from Daily Schedule is rejected.

subtasks.title: Configure Weight Targets
subtasks.purpose: Set recommended weight / body-fat / BMI ranges and the three daily weigh-in windows (Morning, Afternoon, Evening).

steps.title: Scroll to Weight Targets
steps.description: Scroll to the Weight Targets section.

steps.title: Review Auto-Derived Ranges
steps.description: Recommended Weight Range and Recommended Body Fat Range are auto-derived (shown in lb / %); no direct input.

steps.title: Enter Weight Target Range
steps.description: Enter Weight Target Range (lb) — e.g. 66 – 220.

steps.title: Enter Body Fat Range
steps.description: Enter Body Fat Target Range (%) — e.g. 14 – 27.

steps.title: Set BMI Cut-Offs
steps.description: Under BMI Target Range, enter the upper cut-offs for Normal (18.5), Overweight (25) and Obese (30); the Underweight bucket is bounded by the Normal cut-off.

steps.title: Set Time-of-Day Windows
steps.description: Set the Morning window (e.g. 06:00 AM – 03:59 PM), the Afternoon window (12:00 PM – 09:59 PM) and the Evening window (06:00 PM – 09:59 AM next day).

steps.title: Save or Review History
steps.description: Click Save; use Cancel to revert or Event Logs for history. Notes BMI cut-offs are inclusive — a reading equal to the Normal cut-off falls in the Normal bucket. The Recommended Weight and Body Fat ranges refresh only after the patient profile (height, age, sex) is updated. Task 7.10 — Import Patients Tab
